purpose: Slicer scripted module that guides an operator through the ASTM F2554 tracking-system accuracy tests. It uses a phantom and pointer, with transforms streamed over OpenIGTLink from a Plus server. It records measurements and writes JSON and HTML reports for tracker users such as Atracsys customers.
summary: I read the module, helper classes, CMake files, license and sample resources. I found no malicious behavior, network exfiltration, package installation or unsafe deserialization. Data is written only to a user-chosen folder. The CMake files install what the module imports, and the dependencies match. The license is the Slicer BSD-style license. Findings are non-blocking: a hidden password-gated developer mode that can fake calibration, target hits and skipped tests in a tool meant to produce standards-compliance data; a NameError bug in an error path; a modal folder dialog at module setup that leaves the module half-initialised if cancelled; and global side effects on the main window and root logger. The source is on the `master` branch, so I could not verify an exact revision. Recommend merge, with the suggestions as non-blocking.
